steps.explanation: The forwarder may then move CL Operating's USDC, but only to its off-ramp and only within the allowance the next call sets. steps.title: CL Operating: let the SettlementForwarder move up to $5,000.00 of USDC every 7 days
steps.explanation: The most the funding desk can push from CL Operating to the off-ramp in a period, whatever happens to its key: the same cap as the pool lane's. In the Safe app open CL Operating, load the batch in Transaction Builder, confirm it from the Clear Lending Safe (a nested-Safe confirmation, both owners), then execute. Sign all four at once: safe-batches/signing-SL-cl-operating.json (written while they are ready).
steps.signerLabel: CL Operating (its owner, the Clear Lending Safe, signs in the Safe app)

steps.signerLabel: Clear Treasury Safe (its owners sign in the Safe app)
